sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*2\.5 years[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '19958854' LIMIT 5
rows: The trial will continue until 1,600 primary end point events have occurred, all evaluable subjects have been followed for at least 2 years, and 80% of evaluable subjects have been followed for at least 2.5 years
